statements.notes: Primal Defense(R) Kids is a combination of prebiotics and probiotics that support normal bowel function and healthy immune system.
This unique formula uses 3 Bifidobacteria strains that have been clinically studied in children and are found in a healthy child's digestive tract.
Insulin, a prebiotic, supports growth of friendly intestinal bacteria and maintains healthy calcium absorption to support your child's growth.
Most importantly, Primal Defense(R) Kids is made with a hint of natural banana, so kids will love the taste!
Suggested Use: Shake before each use. For kids 3 years or older, add 1/4 teaspoon to food or beverage once daily. May increase to 1/2 tsp. if desired. Use a clean, dry spoon.
Caution: As with any dietary supplement, consult your healthcare practitioner before using.
Warning: Severely immunosuppressed children should not use before consulting a physician.
Store in a cool, dry place. Does not require refrigeration.
Contains no artificial colors, preservatives or sweeteners.
